content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD surface_wave_1d simple case that plots one surface-elevation snapshot over a reconstructed bathymetry with wavemaker and sponge-layer overlays. It reconstructs the domain (m=1024, dx=1.0, L4-L5) and a flat 10 m depth with a plane slope SLP=0.05 starting at Xslp=800.0 (L6-L7, L10-L12), draws a wavemaker box centered at x=250 with half-width wd=10 (L15-L16) and a sponge-layer box spanning x=0..180 (L17) using rectangle outline vertices yy (L18), sets an 8x4-inch figure (L20-L22), loads snapshot eta_00014 (L25), and plots -dep and eta versus x with red wavemaker outline, black sponge outline, text labels, axis [0 1024 -1 1], grid, and axis labels (L26-L35).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
dep — depth array, flat 10.0 then plane slope beyond Xslp (L11-L12)
yy — rectangle y-vertices shared by both overlays (L18)
eta — surface elevation loaded from eta_00014 (L25)

io.name: figure with -dep, eta, wavemaker and sponge-layer outlines vs x

unresolved: dep=zeros(m)+10.0 (L11) creates an m-by-m matrix (zeros with a single scalar argument), not a length-m vector; plot(x,-dep,...) (L26) then plots x against matrix columns — works but relies on MATLAB implicit expansion of the masked assignment at L12; whether this was intended over zeros(1,m) is not stated in the file.
fdir is a hardcoded developer-specific absolute path (L2).
Snapshot eta_00014 is hardcoded (L25); the correspondence to a physical time depends on the model output interval, which is not in this file.
Wavemaker center 250 and sponge extent 180 (L16-L17) are asserted graphically; agreement with the case input.txt values is not verifiable from this script.
